newsitem.title: USA: New Age board okays conversion to open-end.
newsitem.headline: New Age board okays conversion to open-end.

text.p: New Age Media Fund said Wednesday its board had approved a management proposal to convert the fund from closed-end to open-end status.
If approved by shareholders at the annual meeting, the fund will become an open-end fund later this year, it said.
The $219 million fund began operations in October 1993. It invests primarily in media and technology companies involved in the production and distribution of multimedia information.

James Riepe, a managing director of T. Rowe Price and chairman of the fund, said the conversion is being sought to reduce the persistent and significant discount between the fund's net asset value per share and its stock price.
T. Rowe Price is the fund's investment manager and administrator.
